guide.description: Switch among three meeting scripts and preview the full rhythm—from preparation to a report—without a model key or a real meeting record.

brainstorm.cheat: Open with the audience challenge. Ask for one bold direction at a time, then transition into the agreed reach, clarity, and cost screen.
brainstorm.copyReason: The team needs to open the possibility space before choosing.
brainstorm.label: Brainstorm together
brainstorm.modeEffect: This script protects divergence first, then adds an explicit convergence step so the room does not stop at a pile of ideas.
brainstorm.outcome1: Three concepts move into lightweight testing
brainstorm.outcome2: Mina owns the audience remix prototype
brainstorm.outcome3: Team will select with reach, clarity, and cost
brainstorm.question: Who must remember or act on the launch message?
brainstorm.rawRequest: We need fresh launch ideas for a developer tool without repeating the usual feature announcement.
brainstorm.readinessSummary: The challenge is clear; the audience and selection method still need sharper boundaries.
brainstorm.reason: A concrete audience gives the room a useful lens without closing ideas too early.
brainstorm.report:
# Launch angle brainstorm

## Candidate ideas
- Specialist proof
- Product-in-use story
- Customer remix

## Next test
Score three concepts by reach, clarity, and cost.
brainstorm.title: Launch angle brainstorm

decision.cheat: Open by naming the decision and owner. Move from options to criteria, surface the deciding risk, then restate who makes the call.
decision.copyReason: The request requires a concrete choice among alternatives.
decision.label: Align on a decision
decision.modeEffect: This script makes the owner, alternatives, criteria, risks, and deadline visible before the room tries to decide.
decision.outcome2: Leah owns the compliance check by Friday
decision.outcome3: Revisit expansion after two weeks of data
decision.question: Who owns the final call if the room cannot agree?
decision.rawRequest: Choose whether we launch globally, start in one region, or delay for the compliance review.
decision.readinessSummary: The options are known; decision ownership and risk tolerance remain incomplete.
decision.reason: Without a named decision owner, discussion can end in polite ambiguity.
decision.report:
# Launch plan decision

## Decision
Start with one region and a gated beta.

## Action
Leah completes the compliance check by Friday.

## Revisit
Review expansion after two weeks of launch data.
decision.title: Choose the launch plan

retro.cheat: Open with shared facts. Keep causes separate from blame, ask for a counterexample, then close on one owned improvement.
retro.copyReason: The team needs to understand a past result and agree on an improvement.
retro.label: Reflect and improve
retro.modeEffect: This script separates facts from interpretation, searches for causes and counterexamples, then turns learning into owned changes.
retro.outcome2: Ravi owns alert-threshold review by Tuesday
retro.question: What happened that everyone in the room would agree is a fact?
retro.rawRequest: Review last week's failed release, understand why recovery was slow, and agree on what to change.
retro.readinessSummary: The incident scope is known; facts and expected-versus-actual behavior need separation.
retro.reason: Starting from shared facts keeps the retro from becoming a contest of opinions.
retro.report:
# Release incident retro

## What happened
Detection and rollback were both late.

## Change
Rehearse rollback before high-risk releases.

## Owner
Ravi reviews alert thresholds by Tuesday.
retro.title: Release incident retro

ai.INPUT_INVALID: The request could not be classified. Check the raw request and optional title, then retry.
ai.ORIGIN_INVALID: This request could not be verified. Reload Convergene and try again.
ai.OUTPUT_INVALID: The model returned an unusable recommendation. Retry once or choose a script manually.
ai.OUTPUT_LANGUAGE_MISMATCH: The recommendation used the wrong language. Retry or choose a script manually; your input is unchanged.
ai.PROVIDER_AUTH_FAILED: The provider rejected the saved key. Reconnect it, then retry.
ai.PROVIDER_CONFIG_INVALID: The saved model configuration can no longer be used. Replace it, then retry.
ai.PROVIDER_CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE: Model configuration storage is temporarily unavailable. Your form is still here; retry later or choose manually.
ai.PROVIDER_MODEL_NOT_FOUND: The approved model is unavailable for this account. Check model settings or choose manually.
ai.PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED: Connect your own model provider to get a recommendation, or choose manually.
ai.PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED: The provider is limiting requests. Wait a moment, then retry or choose manually.
ai.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The provider could not be reached. Your inputs are preserved; retry or choose manually.
ai.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts were made from this session. Wait a minute or choose manually.
ai.REQUEST_CANCELLED: The prior recommendation was cancelled. You can retry when ready.
ai.UNKNOWN: Something unexpected interrupted the recommendation. Your input is unchanged; retry or choose manually.
